title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: The family is excited to witness Pallavan receiving his degree at the convocation. Although happy about his achievement, Nadesan is hesitant to attend due to Pallavan's resentment.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: While Madhu is with Arjun, her father promises her to Shyam. Despite Madhu's refusal, her mother presents her to Shyam's family, pushing Madhu to reject Shyam as she loves Arjun.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Upset by Vadivu's outburst, Muthuvel checks with Sakthivel and Pandian, who invites the family for lunch. Meanwhile, Palanivel rejoices as Suganya delivers a baby girl.
